name: Mind Games cuts Hallucination's cooldown and mana cost through the native spell-mod system (#1202)
contract: 582589 effect0 is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 11 = SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, BasePoints -5001 / DieSides 1 -> value -5000 ms, matching $/1000;s1=5 sec. Effect1 is aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 14 = SPELLMOD_COST, BasePoints -21 / DieSides 1 -> value -20, matching $s2=20%. Both effects' EffectSpellClassMask dwordB bit2 (4) exactly and singularly match Hallucination (560301)'s own SpellFamilyFlags dwordB bit2 -- verified from Spell.dbc, distinct from the unrelated same-named 503652/504873/706932 rows (706932 is the Cultist's own summon-trigger helper, per CultistSummonSpells in AscensionCultistData.h). Hallucination's native RecoveryTime is 30000 ms. The harness's spell_modifier metric applies the player's native spell mods to a supplied base through Player::ApplySpellMod, reading both routed operations without submitting a cast.
